tool.name: call_store_revision_agent
tool.description: Required first step for managed knowledge changes. Delegate complete requirements and an existing draftId to the Store Revision Agent; formal content is read-only, and only drafts may be edited. Continue the same Agent conversation and draft after a review is returned for changes.
